rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an ironic situation and also works for satirical or mocking content.

example.english: It was really ironic to announce water conservation on a day of heavy rain.
example.traditional: 喺落大雨嗰日宣布要慳水，真係好諷刺。
example.jyutping: hai2 lok6 daai6 jyu5 go2 jat6 syun1 bou3 jiu3 haan1 seoi2 zan1 hai6 hou2 fung3 ci3

rows.note: Use this when the irony is conveyed by saying the opposite of what is meant, especially in teasing or mocking speech.

example.english: When Mum said I was really clever, I knew she was being ironic.
example.traditional: 阿媽話我真係醒，我知佢係講反話。
example.jyutping: aa3 maa1 waa6 ngo5 zan1 hai6 seng2 ngo5 zi1 keoi5 hai6 gong2 faan2 waa2

rows.note: Use this for a person's snide or teasing tone in casual speech, rather than for an ironic situation itself.

example.english: You don't have to be so ironic; I know you're only joking.
example.traditional: 你唔使咁串喎，我知你講笑咋。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 sai2 gam3 cyun3 wo3 ngo5 zi1 nei5 gong2 siu3 zaa3
